publicVideo.title: How to Export and Re-Import Your Nostr Keys
publicVideo.availability: The public watch page loaded and showed the exact title, official Nostr WoT channel, 1 minute 19 second duration and tutorial description.
publicVideo.descriptionSummary: Demonstrates exporting and restoring a Nostr private key or password-protected ncryptsec backup with the extension.

websiteEvidence.directBrowserResult: The production guide loaded with its title, body, seven-language selector, security screenshot and both registered video walkthroughs.

practicalProblem: Helps readers test whether an exported private key or encrypted ncryptsec backup can restore the same identity before a browser migration or device loss.

openPullRequestsEvaluated: PR #67 is an older draft for broader account setup guides and was not merged or modified.
PR #61 is an unrelated homepage change and was not merged or modified.

ownWorkCandidatesEvaluated.extensionRelease: GitHub-only versions newer than 0.8.17 were not presented as store available. Chrome Web Store and Firefox Add-ons still showed 0.8.17 in the freshest primary listings available to this run.
ownWorkCandidatesEvaluated.sdkPackages: The latest verified stable identity 1.1.0 and nostr-wot-sdk 3.0.1 publication was already covered and delivered. No duplicate product update was created.
ownWorkCandidatesEvaluated.otherTutorials: Other unshared public tutorials remain eligible for future recovery, including zaps, language, account removal and authentication. This key backup tutorial was selected because restoring the same identity is a concrete security and migration problem.

rotationAssessment: Recent newsroom work is guide-heavy. No newer store-approved extension release or unreported stable SDK publication cleared the product-update bar, so the verified own-work backlog candidate was selected without inventing a release. A later cycle should rebalance toward ecosystem news or a meaningful project update when one clears the bar.

channelEligibility.reason: This is the Nostr WoT team's own substantive published key backup and recovery tutorial with a seven-language guide.

claimsNotMade: No claim that key export or import is a new software release.
No claim that GitHub-only extension versions are available in browser stores.
No claim that a local vault password can recover a lost identity.
No claim that exporting a backup proves it is recoverable without a restoration test.
